# PharmaLink

> Prescription-led medical support, generic medicine information, and specialty drug coordination for documented requests.

- Primary URL: https://mtd006.github.io/pharmalink/
- Organization: PharmaLink
- Service area: India to the USA
- Content type: Single-page website with a crawlable medicine directory

## Summary
PharmaLink provides document-led coordination for prescription medicine requests. The site includes service information, contact details, disclaimers, app installation guidance, FAQs, and a visible medicine directory built from the attached product list.

## Key search topics
prescription medicine support USA, generic medicine information, oncology medicines, hepatitis medicines, HIV medicines, diabetes medicines, cardiology medicines, autoimmune medicines, specialty drug coordination, prescription-led supply support

## Important notes
- Informational and coordination-focused content only
- Prescription-led requests only
- Medical advice, prescribing, and treatment suitability must come from licensed healthcare professionals

## Main sections
- Homepage and service overview: https://mtd006.github.io/pharmalink/
- Medicine directory: https://mtd006.github.io/pharmalink/#medicine-directory
- Contact: https://mtd006.github.io/pharmalink/#contact
- Terms and disclaimers: https://mtd006.github.io/pharmalink/#terms
